newsitem.title: FRANCE: American Airlines to lift ex-France rates May 5.
newsitem.headline: American Airlines to lift ex-France rates May 5.

text.p: American Airlines said it was raising its ex-Paris cargo rates, effective May 5.

"The increases will probably vary between three and five percent depending on the destination and customer and will co-incide with the revision of our pricing structure," a Paris-based AA cargo official told Reuters.
AA Cargo's last general increase in its ex-Paris rates dated back to Spring 1996, the official added.
"We had a very good last quarter of 1996 and demand has remained buoyant so far in 1997, with French exports faring well in the light of a stronger dollar."
American operates daily passenger flights from Paris to New York, Chicago, Boston, Miami and Dallas. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
